title: Psalm 115
opening_line: Not unto us, LORD, not to us,

source.note: Received text from the official Free Church digital edition and plain-text archive.

text.diplomatic: Not unto us, LORD, not to us,
text.normalized: Not unto us, LORD, not to us,
text.reading: Not unto us, LORD, not to us,

text.diplomatic: but do thou glory take
text.normalized: But do thou glory take
text.reading: but do thou glory take

text.diplomatic: Unto thy name, ev’n for thy truth,
text.normalized: Unto thy name, ev’n for thy truth,
text.reading: Unto thy name, ev’n for thy truth,

text.diplomatic: and for thy mercy’s sake.
text.normalized: And for thy mercy’s sake.
text.reading: and for thy mercy’s sake.

text.diplomatic: O wherefore should the heathen say,
text.normalized: O wherefore should the heathen say,
text.reading: O wherefore should the heathen say,

text.diplomatic: Where is their God now gone?
text.normalized: Where is their God now gone?
text.reading: Where is their God now gone?

text.diplomatic: But our God in the heavens is,
text.normalized: But our God in the heavens is,
text.reading: But our God in the heavens is,

text.diplomatic: what pleased him he hath done.
text.normalized: What pleased him he hath done.
text.reading: what pleased him he hath done.

text.diplomatic: Their idols silver are and gold,
text.normalized: Their idols silver are and gold,
text.reading: Their idols silver are and gold,

text.diplomatic: work of men’s hands they be.
text.normalized: Work of men’s hands they be.
text.reading: work of men’s hands they be.

text.diplomatic: Mouths have they, but they do not speak;
text.normalized: Mouths have they, but they do not speak;
text.reading: Mouths have they, but they do not speak;

text.diplomatic: and eyes, but do not see;
text.normalized: And eyes, but do not see;
text.reading: and eyes, but do not see;

text.diplomatic: Ears have they, but they do not hear;
text.normalized: Ears have they, but they do not hear;
text.reading: Ears have they, but they do not hear;

text.diplomatic: noses, but savour not;
text.normalized: Noses, but savour not;
text.reading: noses, but savour not;

text.diplomatic: Hands, feet, but handle not, nor walk;
text.normalized: Hands, feet, but handle not, nor walk;
text.reading: Hands, feet, but handle not, nor walk;

text.diplomatic: nor speak they through their throat.
text.normalized: Nor speak they through their throat.
text.reading: nor speak they through their throat.

text.diplomatic: Like them their makers are, and all
text.normalized: Like them their makers are, and all
text.reading: Like them their makers are, and all

text.diplomatic: on them their trust that build.
text.normalized: On them their trust that build.
text.reading: on them their trust that build.

text.diplomatic: O Isr’el, trust thou in the LORD,
text.normalized: O Isr’el, trust thou in the LORD,
text.reading: O Isr’el, trust thou in the LORD,

text.diplomatic: he is their help and shield.
text.normalized: He is their help and shield.
text.reading: he is their help and shield.

text.diplomatic: O Aaron’s house, trust in the LORD,
text.normalized: O Aaron’s house, trust in the LORD,
text.reading: O Aaron’s house, trust in the LORD,

text.diplomatic: their help and shield is he.
text.normalized: Their help and shield is he.
text.reading: their help and shield is he.

text.diplomatic: Ye that fear God, trust in the LORD,
text.normalized: Ye that fear God, trust in the LORD,
text.reading: Ye that fear God, trust in the LORD,

text.diplomatic: their help and shield he’ll be.
text.normalized: Their help and shield he’ll be.
text.reading: their help and shield he’ll be.

text.diplomatic: The LORD of us hath mindful been,
text.normalized: The LORD of us hath mindful been,
text.reading: The LORD of us hath mindful been,

text.diplomatic: and he will bless us still:
text.normalized: And he will bless us still:
text.reading: and he will bless us still:

text.diplomatic: He will the house of Isr’el bless,
text.normalized: He will the house of Isr’el bless,
text.reading: He will the house of Isr’el bless,

text.diplomatic: bless Aaron’s house he will.
text.normalized: Bless Aaron’s house he will.
text.reading: bless Aaron’s house he will.

text.diplomatic: Both small and great, that fear the LORD,
text.normalized: Both small and great, that fear the LORD,
text.reading: Both small and great, that fear the LORD,

text.diplomatic: he will them surely bless.
text.normalized: He will them surely bless.
text.reading: he will them surely bless.

text.diplomatic: The LORD will you, you and your seed,
text.normalized: The LORD will you, you and your seed,
text.reading: The LORD will you, you and your seed,

text.diplomatic: aye more and more increase.
text.normalized: Aye more and more increase.
text.reading: aye more and more increase.

text.diplomatic: O blessèd are ye of the LORD,
text.normalized: O blessèd are ye of the LORD,
text.reading: O blessèd are ye of the LORD,

text.diplomatic: who made the earth and heav’n.
text.normalized: Who made the earth and heav’n.
text.reading: who made the earth and heav’n.

text.diplomatic: The heav’n, ev’n heav’ns, are GOD’s, but he
text.normalized: The heav’n, ev’n heav’ns, are GOD’s, but he
text.reading: The heav’n, ev’n heav’ns, are GOD’s, but he

text.diplomatic: earth to men’s sons hath giv’n.
text.normalized: Earth to men’s sons hath giv’n.
text.reading: earth to men’s sons hath giv’n.

text.diplomatic: The dead, nor who to silence go,
text.normalized: The dead, nor who to silence go,
text.reading: The dead, nor who to silence go,

text.diplomatic: GOD’s praise do not record.
text.normalized: GOD’s praise do not record.
text.reading: GOD’s praise do not record.

text.diplomatic: But henceforth we for ever will
text.normalized: But henceforth we for ever will
text.reading: But henceforth we for ever will

text.diplomatic: bless GOD. Praise ye the LORD.
text.normalized: Bless GOD. Praise ye the LORD.
text.reading: bless GOD. Praise ye the LORD.
